mapper.select: SELECT A.HIS_SEQ, B.SCH_CODE, D.CON_SEQ, D.CON_NM, D.CON_SCREEN, D.CON_TYPE, D.CON_USEYN, D.CON_WIDTH, D.CON_HEIGHT, D.CON_MID, D.CON_TIME, D.CON_NEXTSEQ, D.CON_FILE, D.CON_LOCALFILE, B.SCH_EMERGUBUN FROM TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY A JOIN TB_SCHEDULE B ON A.SCH_CODE = B.SCH_CODE JOIN TB_DIDINFO C ON A.DID_ID = C.DID_ID JOIN TB_CONTENTMUTIL D ON B.CONTENT_CODE = D.CON_SEQ WHERE TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') >= B.SCH_STARTDAY AND B.SCH_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.DID_UPDATECHECK = 'N' AND C.DID_ID = #{didId} AND TRIM(C.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} AND B.SCH_USEYN = 'Y' ORDER BY ( CASE B.SCH_EMERGUBUN WHEN 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END ) ASC, A.HIS_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CON_SEQ, CON_NM, CON_SCREEN, CON_TYPE, CON_USEYN, CON_WIDTH, CON_HEIGHT, CON_MID, CON_TIME, CON_NEXTSEQ, CON_FILE, CON_LOCALFILE FROM TB_CONTENTMUTIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}

SELECT A.CON_SEQ AS conSeq, A.CON_SCREEN AS conScreen, A.CON_TYPE AS conType, A.CON_USEYN AS conUseYn, A.CON_WIDTH AS conWidth, A.CON_HEIGHT AS conHeight, A.CON_MID AS conMid, A.CON_NM AS conNm, A.CON_TIME AS conTime, A.CON_NEXTSEQ AS conNextSeq, A.CON_FILE AS conFile, A.CON_LOCALFILE AS conLocalfile, B.DETAIL_SEQ AS detailSeq, B.DETAIL_ORDER AS detailOrder, B.CON_TYPE AS conTypeD, B.IMAGE_SLIDTYPE AS imageSlidType, B.TIME_INTERVAL AS timeIntervalD, A.CON_PLAYTYPE AS conPlayType, A.CON_BASICURL AS conBasicUrl, A.CON_URLTYPE AS conUrlType FROM TB_CONTENTMUTIL A JOIN TB_CONDETAIL B ON A.CON_SEQ = B.CON_SEQ WHERE B.DETAIL_ORDER IS NOT NULL AND A.CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}

SELECT A.CON_NM AS conNm, FN_DETAILCODENM(A.CON_SCREEN) AS codeNm, FN_DETAILCODENM(A.CON_TYPE) AS conType, A.CON_USEYN AS conUseYn, A.CON_WIDTH AS conWidth, A.CON_HEIGHT AS conHeight, A.CON_MID AS conMid, A.CON_SCREEN AS conScreen, A.CON_SEQ AS conSeq, A.CON_NEXTSEQ AS conNextSeq, A.CON_FILE AS conFile, CASE A.CON_NEXTSEQ WHEN '0' THEN 'NO DATA' ELSE ( SELECT B.CON_NM FROM TB_CONTENTMUTIL B WHERE B.CON_SEQ = CAST(A.CON_NEXTSEQ AS INTEGER) ) END AS conNextTitle, FN_DETAILCODENM(A.CON_PLAYTYPE) AS conPlayType, FN_DETAILCODENM(A.CON_URLTYPE) AS conUrlType, A.CON_BASICURL AS conBasicUrl, FN_DETAILCODEDOC(A.CON_SCREEN) AS conDc, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(CAST(TIME_INTERVAL AS INTEGER), 0)), 0) FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = A.CON_SEQ) AS conTime, TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS frstRegistPnttm, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SCHEDULE WHERE CONTENT_CODE = A.CON_SEQ ) AS schCnt FROM TB_CONTENTMUTIL A WHERE A.CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}
SELECT COALESCE(TIME_INTERVAL, '0') FROM TB_CONDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq} ORDER BY TIME_INTERVAL DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(CON_SEQ) FROM TB_CONTENT), 0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(CON_SEQ) FROM TB_CONTENTMUTIL), 0) ) + 1 AS VARCHAR)

INSERT INTO TB_CONTENTMUTIL ( CON_SEQ, CON_NM, CON_SCREEN, CON_TYPE, CON_USEYN, CON_WIDTH, CON_HEIGHT, CON_MID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, CON_TIME, CON_NEXTSEQ, CON_PLAYTYPE, CON_BASICURL, CON_URLTYPE, CON_LOCALFILE, GROUP_ID, CENTER_ID ) VALUES ( #{conSeq}, #{conNm}, #{conScreen}, #{conType}, 'Y', #{conWidth,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{conHeight,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{conMid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{mberId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{mberId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0', #{conNextSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{conPlayType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{conBasicUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{conUrlType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{conLocalfile,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{groupId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{centerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONTENTMUTIL SET CON_NM = #{conNm}, CON_SCREEN = #{conScreen}, CON_TYPE = #{conType}, CON_USEYN = #{conUseYn}, CON_WIDTH = #{conWidth,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_HEIGHT = #{conHeight,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_MID = #{conMid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_NEXTSEQ = #{conNextSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_PLAYTYPE = #{conPlayType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_BASICURL = #{conBasicUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_URLTYPE = #{conUrlType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}
